items.title: Abbott (ABT) Lands Exclusive Rights To FDA Approved Blood Based CRC Test
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) has secured exclusive U.S. commercialization rights for Freenome's SimpleScreen CRC, a newly FDA approved blood based colorectal cancer screening test. The approval and commercialization arrangement introduces a new screening option for eligible U.S. patients under current colorectal cancer testing guidelines. This agreement expands Abbott's presence in the colorectal cancer screening category within its broader diagnostics portfolio. For investors watching...

items.title: Freenome secures FDA nod for blood-based colorectal cancer test
items.summary: Abbott will market Freenome’s SimpleScreen CRC test in the U.S., alongside its Cologuard stool test. SimpleScreen will compete with Guardant Health’s Shield blood test for colorectal cancer screening.
